pages.title: Black Hole
pages.text: $(o)A collapsing black hole that drags foes in.$()

The Spiegel copy's spell from ep. 26: a black core in a blazing corona forms at your fingertips, flies slowly along your aim dragging creatures and rubble after it, crushes the rubble into a red-cracked mass, then collapses in a blast.

Plays a short cutscene for the caster (K / Esc skips). Three levels widen the pull. Damage: 0.35× spell power every half second to anything inside it, then 1.6× spell power within 5 blocks when it collapses.
